findings.message: Unbounded string or buffer operation detected (CWE-120). Functions such as strcpy, strcat, sprintf, vsprintf, and gets do not enforce destination buffer bounds and can cause stack/heap buffer overflows. Prefer bounded alternatives such as snprintf, vsnprintf, strlcpy, or fgets.
findings.cwe: CWE-120: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input

findings.message: Non-literal format string passed directly to formatted output function (CWE-134). Attacker-controlled format specifiers (%n, %x, %s) can leak memory or achieve arbitrary write. Always use a literal format string such as "%s".
findings.cwe: CWE-134: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
